taskDisplayName: CP-5.1 exact DB delta certification for release 698c
sourceContext: Continue the fail-closed CP-5.1 release certification through the autonomous ORCHESTOR control plane after the user explicitly authorized proceeding.
objective: Certify the exact minimal database, RLS, RPC, grants and storage delta required for release 698c using repository evidence and the already verified local Production backup/isolated restore, without mutating Production, then publish a gate result stating whether a bounded Production DB change manifest is ready for separate human authorization.
why: The combined deploy gate is correctly fail-closed because Production lacks tables, RPCs and storage dependencies required by 698c. Edge first-deploy rollback and Vercel rollback are already certified, so the only current release blocker is the database contract.
scope: Inspect release 698c database dependencies for expense-document-openai-extraction, expense-document-normalization, V3ExpenseCaptureEntry and their transitive helpers.
Inspect versioned Supabase migrations, SQL, RLS, grants, PostgreSQL functions/RPCs, storage buckets/policies and required extensions.
Compare the required contract with the already verified Production backup or its isolated local restore; do not require live Production access.
Build the exact minimal ordered migration manifest required for 698c and identify drift.
Apply the proposed manifest only to an isolated local restore/copy when safely available, never to Production.
Run bounded local schema/RLS/RPC/storage-contract verification and relevant release tests when safe.
Define exact rollback/recovery strategy per change and flag irreversible changes.
Run independent DB migration, RLS/security, RPC, storage and release-dependency review.
Publish a structured terminal result to orchestrator/control.
outOfScope: Applying the certified Production DB manifest
acceptanceCriteria: Every DB/storage object required by 698c is mapped to repository source and observed local Production-backup state.
PRODUCTION_MIGRATION_MANIFEST is exact, minimal, ordered and excludes unrelated changes.
RLS, grants and SECURITY DEFINER/search_path risks are independently reviewed.
RPC signatures, ownership, grants, security mode, callers and side effects are verified.
Storage bucket/policy requirements are explicit and minimal.
If an isolated restore is usable, the manifest applies there successfully and final local schema satisfies 698c; otherwise the result is BLOCKED with exact missing prerequisite.
Rollback or recovery is defined for every proposed change.
Independent reviewers report P0=0, P1=0 and P2=0 before READY_FOR_PRODUCTION_DB_CHANGE_GATE can be YES.
Production mutations, Edge deploys, Vercel deploys, secret mutations and OpenAI Production calls remain zero.
allowedActions: read repository files and Git history
inspect release 698c and versioned migration SQL
inspect the existing verified local Production backup and isolated restore
create or reuse isolated local test database state outside Production
apply proposed migrations only to an isolated local restore
run local schema, RLS, RPC, storage-contract and relevant application tests
publish the structured result only to orchestrator/control
forbiddenActions: create or alter Production storage buckets or policies
change Production RLS, grants, RPCs or schema
read, print or expose secret values
stopConditions: Any step would require a Production mutation.
Any required credential or secret value would need to be exposed to the model.
The verified backup/isolated restore cannot be located or its identity cannot be established safely.
A required migration cannot be separated from unrelated or destructive changes.
Observed evidence conflicts with release 698c or the certified backup.
Rollback/recovery cannot be demonstrated for a proposed Production change.
Any reviewer reports P0, P1 or P2.
verificationRequirements: Produce REQUIRED_TABLES, REQUIRED_COLUMNS, REQUIRED_RPCS, REQUIRED_RLS_POLICIES, REQUIRED_GRANTS and REQUIRED_STORAGE.
Produce object-by-object matrix: required object, source migration, observed backup state, required change, blocker status.
Produce PRODUCTION_MIGRATION_MANIFEST with dependency order, transactional/destructive/data-rewrite flags, lock risk and rollback strategy.
Verify local isolated restore migration test when feasible.
Verify final local schema compatibility with 698c when feasible.
Run independent DB migration, RLS/security, RPC, storage and release-dependency reviewers.
